our_interpretation: Assess the forecast that AGI would not arrive by the end of 2029. The personal stakes are background, not a company financial claim.

Use the original published offer's operational test: success on at least three of five tasks involving movie comprehension, novel comprehension, cooking in an arbitrary kitchen, reliably producing more than 10,000 lines of bug-free code, and formalizing arbitrary mathematical proofs.
The original offer left detailed ground rules open. Its explicit single-system requirement was added in June 2024 and is not treated as an original 2022 stipulation.
I think expresses uncertainty; it is not an antecedent that must occur.
An eventual outcome can assess the forecast's direction, but cannot establish whether its original probability judgment was well calibrated.
